MARS HARNESS LAB • START HERE

What if research and development could move faster?

A great deal of R&D time is spent gathering sources, recording decisions, revising designs, checking documents, and coordinating work. AI agents can help carry out those repeatable steps while scientists, engineers, and project leaders set the goals, judge the evidence, and approve the results.

Explore the labGet free materials
01 • SCIENCE

Run the scientific method.

Frame a question, find and compare evidence, propose testable hypotheses, plan experiments or simulations, analyze results, and prepare work for independent critique.

02 • ENGINEERING

Develop and test designs.

Turn evidence into requirements, compare concepts, build models and schematics, review risks, and verify that a design meets its stated needs.

03 • PROJECT DELIVERY

Plan and execute the work.

Build schedules and task plans, assign owners, follow dependencies, record changes, and track whether the promised work was completed.

FROM ONE AGENT TO A CONNECTED PROCESS

Why chain specialized harnesses?

A harness gives an AI model instructions, tools, memory, and checks so it can work through a task. Coding agents brought this approach into everyday software development. Newer tools such as OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Bot, and OpenWork show agents working across communication, files, and other computer tasks. Codex shows how a coding harness can be extended through tools and integrations.

This lab takes the next step: connect purpose-built science, engineering, and project harnesses. Each passes a checked work product to the next, with evidence and human approval at the handoff. That could compress long cycles and sharply reduce hours spent on routine research, documentation, and coordination. The size of any time or labor savings depends on the project and must be measured; physical testing, expert judgment, and accountability remain essential.

Start with the lab overview, then follow the three application workflows.

MARS PROJECT TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE • 23 SEPTEMBER 2026

From LLM
to mission system.

An LLM is a probabilistic reasoning engine. A harness turns it into a bounded agent with identity, tools, memory, typed work products, independent checks, and human authority. Mars Harness Lab chains three code-grounded SaaS patterns—Hypatia, Intelligent Engineer, and PM Accelerator—without confusing generated work with verified evidence.

01 • FOUNDATIONS

What an LLM is—and what the harness must supply.

A large language model predicts tokens from learned parameters and the current context. That makes it useful for synthesis, planning, code, and structured reasoning, but it does not make the model an authoritative database, durable project system, laboratory, or approval body.

MODEL

Probabilistic inference component

The model transforms instructions and selected context into candidate text, code, plans, schemas, geometry instructions, or tool calls. Its output is a proposal until observed, checked, and accepted.

Strong at
Pattern recognition, synthesis, decomposition, translation, code, and interface reasoning
Weak alone
Fresh facts, persistent state, exact permissions, physical validation, and accountable approval
Failure modes
Hallucination, context loss, prompt injection, cascade error, automation bias, and silent assumption
HARNESS

Deterministic control shell

The harness decides what the model may see, do, return, retain, retry, and promote. It converts free-form generation into an auditable state machine.

Controls
Role, phase state, retrieval, tool permissions, schema, budget, tests, memory, and approval
Core loop
Frame → retrieve → generate → act → observe → validate → critique → repair → approve → persist
Result
Versioned artifacts with evidence, owners, uncertainty, decisions, and rollback

02Role instructions

03 • CONTROLLED ACCELERATION LOOP

Research → engineer → return blockers → engineer to closure.

Acceleration comes from preserved context, typed artifacts, and independent gates—not from claiming that concept generation replaces physical testing, qualification, certification, or mission acceptance.

01

Research

Build a decision-linked evidence ledger, competing hypotheses, study plan, uncertainty model, and reproducibility record.

02

Engineer

Derive requirements, architectures, interfaces, geometry, schematics, margins, risks, configurations, and verification methods.

03

Return blockers

Issue a typed research request linked to the exact requirement, variable bound, acceptance criterion, owner, and consequence.

04

Execute + close

Authorize owned work, collect actuals and acceptance evidence, propagate approved change, and archive the final baseline.

Promotion invariant

No attractive artifact promotes an entire package. Each branch advances only when its own evidence, configuration, acceptance tests, reviewer, and authority satisfy the contract.

Inherited charter

Every agent preserves human authority, life and health, rights, privacy, security, fairness, accessibility, scientific integrity, and environmental stewardship. Permissions narrow through delegation; they never expand silently. No agent is the sole approver of its own mission-critical work.

05 • RECURSIVE SPECIALIST ORGANIZATION

Three accountable domains. Sixty-seven standing roles. Narrower experts on demand.

The eleven installable agents form the control spine. Domain directors select the smallest adequate specialist bench under a typed spawn contract; deeper delegation cannot widen permissions, budget, or authority.

HUMAN MISSION AUTHORITY→MARS HARNESS DIRECTOR→SCIENCE • ENGINEERING • PROGRAM

Program controls coordination and authorization; technical authorities retain scientific and engineering approval.
EVERY SPAWN IS A CONTRACT

Bound the work before multiplying the workers.

  1. Define objective, parent, scope, exclusions, baseline, evidence, and output.
  2. Limit tools, data, time, cost, iterations, child count, depth, and authority.
  3. Execute with typed packets, stable IDs, and explicit configuration.
  4. Review independently; preserve findings, dissent, and residual risk.
  5. Retire access at the return condition and persist the audit record.
GROUND-TRUTH CASE • SCALED MOXIE

Evidence class controls the claim.

NASA’s MOXIE flight demonstration is observed evidence. Crew-scale production targets and plant values are modeled concepts. Reliability, qualification, and flight readiness remain unknown until the appropriate engineering and test evidence exists.

OBSERVED16 runs • 122 g • 12 g/h • ≥98% purityPASS
MODELED304 kWe • 592 t • 585 t • 7.4 t • 33.8 kg/hTRACE
UNKNOWNCrew-scale reliability, qualification, and flight readinessBLOCK

Modeled values require the calculation references and assumptions in the case-study and claims-ledger files; they are not flight-test results.

Open stage packetRead case study
PORTABLE CONTROL CONTRACT

Same safety envelope. Different agent runtimes.

Each runtime maps native capabilities to the same identity, state, evidence, tool, validation, approval, and memory contracts. An unavailable capability returns a blocked packet; it is never simulated as success.
